verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms cubic serves an llms.txt at docs.cubic.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and markdown versions of its doc pages. Those .md pages direct agents to the complete documentation index in llms.txt. cubic also ships agent skills that give coding agents instructions. Missing for 10: evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant, and independent user reports of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.cubic.dev/llms.txt # cubic documentation
Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.cubic.dev/llms.txt
cubic skills give your coding agent instructions for reviewing code, handling PR comments, and using your team's codebase context.
